317: def _gradient_compare(torch,reference,candidate,tol,label,checks):
318:     if reference.shape!=candidate.shape or reference.dtype!=torch.float64 or candidate.dtype!=torch.float64 or reference.device.type!="cpu" or candidate.device.type!="cpu":
319:         raise ValueError("Gradient comparison requires equal CPU float64 vectors")
320:     delta=candidate-reference
321:     norm=float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(reference));err=float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(delta))
322:     maximum=float(delta.abs().max());refmax=float(reference.abs().max())
323:     relative=err/norm if norm>0 else float("inf")
324:     allowance=tol["max_absolute"]+tol["max_relative_to_reference_max"]*refmax
325:     passed=bool(torch.isfinite(candidate).all() and norm>tol["reference_norm_strictly_above"] and relative<=tol["relative_L2"] and maximum<=allowance)
326:     row={"name":label,"reference_L2":norm,"error_L2":err,"relative_L2_error":relative,
327:          "max_absolute_error":maximum,"reference_max_absolute":refmax,"allowed_max_absolute_error":allowance,"passed":passed}
328:     checks.append(row)
329:     if not passed:
330:         raise AssertionError(label+": "+str(row))
331:     return row

334: def _C_signal_checks(torch,R63,pieces,diagnostics,out,raw,tol,checks,label):
335:     signal={}
336:     for name in C_NAMES:
337:         value=float(pieces[name].detach().cpu())
338:         grad,=torch.autograd.grad(pieces[name],out,retain_graph=True,allow_unused=False)
339:         norm=float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(grad.detach().double()).cpu())
340:         passed=value>tol["positive_piece_value_strictly_above"] and norm>tol["nonzero_C_piece_endpoint_gradient_norm_strictly_above"]
341:         signal[name]={"value":value,"endpoint_gradient_L2":norm,"passed":passed}
342:         if not passed:
343:             checks.append({"name":label+"_nonzero_C_signals","pieces":signal,"passed":False})
344:             raise AssertionError(label+": synthetic "+name+" did not exercise a nonzero signal")
345:     gout,graw=torch.autograd.grad(pieces["box_correction"],(out,raw),retain_graph=True,allow_unused=False)
346:     outnorm=float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(gout.detach().double()).cpu())
347:     rawnorm=float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(graw.detach().double()).cpu())
348:     if outnorm<=tol["nonzero_box_output_gradient_norm_strictly_above"] or rawnorm<=tol["nonzero_box_raw_gradient_norm_strictly_above"]:
349:         raise AssertionError("Original C box raw/output paths were not both exercised")
350:     old=float(diagnostics["original_order_loss"].cpu());omitted=float(diagnostics["omitted_order_loss"].cpu())
351:     current=signal["source_order"]["value"]
352:     residual=abs(old-omitted-current)
353:     allowed=tol["source_order_decomposition_atol"]+tol["source_order_decomposition_rtol"]*abs(old)
354:     fraction=float(diagnostics["resolved_pair_fraction"].cpu())
355:     denominator=float(diagnostics["original_nonzero_pair_mass"].cpu())
356:     if residual>allowed or not 0<fraction<1 or denominator<=0:
357:         raise AssertionError("Original C order denominator/overlap fixture failed")
358:     answer={"name":label+"_nonzero_C_signals","pieces":signal,"box_output_gradient_L2":outnorm,"box_raw_gradient_L2":rawnorm,
359:             "source_order_original_nonzero_pair_mass":denominator,"source_order_resolved_pair_fraction":fraction,
360:             "source_order_decomposition_residual":residual,"passed":True}
361:     checks.append(answer)

488: def _Adam_formula_check(torch,initial,arm,tol,checks,label):
489:     opts=tol["optimizer"];bounds=tol["Adam_formula_and_state"]
490:     eps32=torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps;tiny32=torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny
491:     beta1,beta2=opts["betas"];lr=opts["learning_rate"];epsilon=opts["epsilon"]
492:     results={"parameters":{},"exp_avg":{},"exp_avg_sq":{}}
493:     allowances={k:{} for k in results}
494:     rows=[];offset=0;changed=0
495:     for name,p in initial.named_parameters():
496:         size=p.numel();g=arm["update"]["after_clip"][offset:offset+size].reshape(p.shape);offset+=size
497:         p0=p.detach().cpu().double()
498:         update=lr*g/(g.abs()+epsilon)
499:         ideals={"parameters":p0-update,"exp_avg":(1-beta1)*g,"exp_avg_sq":(1-beta2)*g.square()}
500:         row={"name":name,"elements":size}
501:         if not bool((g!=0).any()) and tol["signal"]["require_each_parameter_tensor_nonzero_gradient"]:
502:             raise AssertionError("Synthetic check does not exercise parameter tensor: "+name)
503:         for kind,ideal in ideals.items():
504:             if kind=="parameters":
505:                 rounded=ideal.to(torch.float32)
506:                 up=torch.nextafter(rounded,torch.full_like(rounded,float("inf")))
507:                 down=torch.nextafter(rounded,torch.full_like(rounded,float("-inf")))
508:                 ulp=torch.maximum((up-rounded).abs(),(rounded-down).abs()).double()
509:                 allowance=bounds["parameter_ulp_multiplier"]*ulp+bounds["float32_epsilon_multiplier"]*eps32*update.abs()+bounds["float32_tiny_multiplier"]*tiny32
510:             else:
511:                 allowance=bounds["float32_epsilon_multiplier"]*eps32*ideal.abs()+bounds["float32_tiny_multiplier"]*tiny32
512:             actual=arm["optimizer"][kind][name]
513:             delta=(actual-ideal).abs()
514:             if not bool(torch.isfinite(actual).all() and (delta<=allowance).all()):
515:                 raise AssertionError(label+" first-step Adam "+kind+" formula mismatch: "+name)
516:             results[kind][name]=ideal;allowances[kind][name]=allowance
517:             row[kind+"_max_formula_error"]=float(delta.max())
518:             row[kind+"_max_allowed_error"]=float(allowance.max())
519:         changed+=int((arm["optimizer"]["parameters"][name]!=p0).sum())
520:         rows.append(row)
521:     if changed==0 or not all(v==1 for v in arm["optimizer"]["steps"].values()):
522:         raise AssertionError("Artificial Adam update did not change parameters exactly once")
523:     checks.append({"name":label+"_all_parameter_Adam_formula","parameter_tensors":len(rows),"parameter_elements":offset,
524:                    "changed_parameter_elements":changed,"every_named_parameter_included":True,"passed":True})
525:     return results,allowances,rows

537:             allowance=allow_a[kind][name]+allow_b[kind][name]
538:             residual=(actual-predicted).abs()
539:             if not bool((residual<=allowance).all()):
540:                 raise AssertionError("Paired sensitivity-aware Adam "+kind+" mismatch: "+name)

R65_objective_adapter:
1: """R65 thin objective calls; no data I/O, model construction, RNG, or tests.
2: 
3: The caller supplies already constructed, hash-bound original objective instances.
4: D returns detached values and a detached first-order endpoint derivative.
5: C keeps the original four selected pieces and both out/raw graph paths alive.
6: """
7: from __future__ import annotations
8: 
9: import torch
10: 
11: D_NAMES = ("full_window", "PSD", "noise", "coordinate_RMS", "temporal_joint")
12: D_PIECE_ORDER = ("full_window", "coordinate_RMS", "PSD", "noise", "temporal_joint")
13: C_NAMES = ("source_order", "source_valley", "REAL_identity", "box_correction")
14: 
15: 
16: def joint_total_D(objective, source_endpoint, reference, layout):
17:     """Call all five D terms once on one projected-before-ADC endpoint leaf.
18: 
19:     Returns dict(total, pieces, GY, diagnostics, piece_order), all value/gradient
20:     tensors detached. GY already includes canonical STE and original masses,
21:     weights and reductions; inject it into the original projected out once.
22:     It must not be injected into raw or divided/averaged again.
23:     """
24:     if torch.is_inference_mode_enabled():
25:         raise RuntimeError("joint_total_D requires ordinary autograd, not inference_mode")
26:     with torch.enable_grad():
27:         leaf = source_endpoint.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
28:         result = objective(leaf, reference, layout, terms=D_NAMES)
29:         if tuple(result.pieces) != D_PIECE_ORDER:
30:             raise RuntimeError("Bound joint D piece/reduction order changed")
31:         if result.total.ndim != 0:
32:             raise ValueError("Bound joint D total must be scalar")
33:         gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(result.total, leaf, create_graph=False, retain_graph=False)
34:     return {
35:         "total": result.total.detach(),
36:         "pieces": {name: result.pieces[name].detach() for name in D_PIECE_ORDER},
37:         "GY": gradient.detach(),
38:         "diagnostics": result.diagnostics,
39:         "piece_order": D_PIECE_ORDER,
40:     }
41:

43: def original_C_microbatch(
44:     objective, output, raw, reference, identity_input, identity_bins,
45:     source_psd, source_h, directions, source_interval_low,
46:     source_interval_high, temporal_directions,
47: ):
48:     """Call original nine-term loss once; directly add its four original C terms.
49: 
50:     No C formula is reimplemented. Five microbatch D pieces are evaluated but
51:     returned only as detached discarded values. The caller differentiates total
52:     through the original shared output/raw network graph before the joint update.
53:     """
54:     nine_total, all_pieces, diagnostics = objective(
55:         output, raw, reference, identity_input, identity_bins, source_psd,
56:         source_h, directions, source_interval_low, source_interval_high,
57:         temporal_directions,
58:     )
59:     if set(all_pieces) != set(D_NAMES + C_NAMES):
60:         raise RuntimeError("Bound original nine-term piece set changed")
61:     if any(objective.cfg["loss_weights"][name] != 1.0 for name in C_NAMES):
62:         raise ValueError("Original R65 C weights must all remain one")
63:     pieces = {name: all_pieces[name] for name in C_NAMES}
64:     total = sum(objective.cfg["loss_weights"][name] * pieces[name] for name in C_NAMES)
65:     return {
66:         "total": total,
67:         "pieces": pieces,
68:         "discarded_D_values": {name: all_pieces[name].detach() for name in D_NAMES},
69:         "original_nine_total_value": nine_total.detach(),
70:         "diagnostics": diagnostics,
71:     }
